ValidationRule.description: CP27 (10 Nov): Account questions are mandatory on the Lead for pilot users: Actual Annual Spend (Q2), and Number of Locations (Q6) on an Entity Lead. Conversion sets Status = Qualified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), $Permission.Lead_UI_Rework_Access_CC, OR( ISBLANK(Actual_Annual_Spend_CC__c), AND(ISPICKVAL(Lead_Type_CC__c, "Entity"), ISBLANK(Number_of_Locations_CC__c)) ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the Account questions before converting: Actual Annual Spend, and Number of Locations for an Entity Lead.
